timer.counter: 16-bit wrapping up-counter clocked once per E-cycle and reset to 0000; an FRC_MSB write presets FFF8 while saving the bus byte, and a following FRC_LSB write replaces the full counter with the saved high byte and current low byte
timer.coherent_read: reading high latches low; low reads return that latch
timer.output_compare: match sets OCF and transfers OLVL to P21; comparison is inhibited for the upper-byte write cycle and the following cycle
timer.input_capture: selected P20 edge transfers the synchronized counter and sets ICF; P20 must be configured as input
timer.overflow: TOF is set when the counter increments from FFFF to 0000

flag_clear.ICF: read TCSR while set, then read ICR_MSB
flag_clear.OCF: read TCSR while set, then write either OCR byte
flag_clear.TOF: read TCSR while set, then read FRC_MSB

timer.interrupt: enabled ICF, OCF, and TOF generate IRQ2 and select distinct priority vectors

gpio.port1: eight GPIO pins except in Mode 1, where they drive A0-A7
gpio.port2: five GPIO pins with timer and SCI overrides; P21 is input or timer output only
gpio.port3: eight Mode-7 GPIO pins with DDR, optional IS3 input latch, read- or write-selected active-low OS3 pulse, and IS3 interrupt flag; external address/data bus in expanded modes
gpio.port4: eight Mode-7 GPIO pins; high/full/partial address function in expanded modes according to table 2-1-2
gpio.reset: port DDRs clear synchronously with E; the current output-enable state persists between RES assertion and the next E edge
gpio.port3_latch: an IS3 falling edge captures Port 3 only while latch-enable is set; clearing latch-enable makes the path transparent and a Port-3 DATA read makes it transparent on the following rising E edge
gpio.p3ddr_read: P3DDR is write-only and reads FF without changing the IS3 flag, clear sequence, input latch, or OS3
gpio.p3csr_clear: IS3 flag clears only after P3CSR is read while set followed by a read or write of PORT3 DATA; a new falling edge wins over a coincident clear
gpio.os3: OSS chooses Port-3 DATA reads or writes; a selected access asserts active-low OS3 after its positive E edge and releases it after the following positive E edge, spanning one complete E cycle

sci.compatibility: The asynchronous transmitter, receiver, clocks, controls, flags, and interrupt functions follow the documented HD6801-compatible SCI except for the explicitly listed framing-error transfer rule.
sci.framing_error: A missing stop bit sets ORFE without RDRF and does not transfer the receive shift-register byte into RDR.
sci.implemented_clock_modes: internally clocked NRZ with divisors 16, 128, 1024, and 4096, plus external NRZ divided from eight sampled P22 positive edges per bit
sci.reserved_clock_modes: CC1:CC0=00 has no format or clock source; the wrapper disables the Motorola-only bi-phase engine

operating_modes.mode0: multiplexed manufacturer test mode with internal F000-FFFF ROM except the initial external reset-vector fetch; implemented digitally
operating_modes.mode1: expanded non-multiplexed 64-KiB operation with internal ROM disabled and Ports 1/3/4 carrying address/data; implemented at the normalized boundary
operating_modes.mode2: expanded multiplexed RAM operation with internal ROM disabled; implemented at the normalized boundary
operating_modes.mode4: expanded multiplexed RAM operation equivalent to Mode 2; implemented without Motorola Mode-4 behavior leakage
operating_modes.mode5: non-multiplexed partial decode with internal ROM and external 0100-01FF; implemented at the normalized boundary
operating_modes.mode6: multiplexed partial decode with internal ROM; implemented at the normalized boundary
operating_modes.mode7: single-chip operation with all program memory and vectors in the internal F000-FFFF mask-ROM window; implemented
operating_modes.sleep: SLP stops CPU execution while peripherals continue; an enabled interrupt vectors and a masked request resumes at the following instruction
operating_modes.standby: standby_n_i is sampled at the normalized E boundary; accepted STBY enters reset state, disables program/GPIO activity, preserves RAM and supplied STBY_PWR, and restarts through the reset vector on release

memory_control.RAME: bit 6 resets set and enables the 0080-00FF internal RAM; clearing it disables that physical RAM and exposes the selected mode's documented external or unusable behavior
memory_control.STBY_PWR: read/write retained-supply validity bit; FPGA profile deterministically initializes it to zero on external reset, preserves it through STBY while standby_power_ok_i remains true, and clears it when that input is false
memory_control.address_trap: Modes 0/1/2/4/6 trap instruction fetches from 0000-001F; Mode 5 traps 0000-007F and 0200-EFFF; Mode 7 traps 0000-007F and 0100-EFFF. Normal data accesses do not trap. Table 2-13-1 omits Mode 2; its classifier is inferred from the manual's explicit Mode-2/Mode-4 equivalence.

implementation_scope.rtl: rtl/hd6301/hd6301v1_mcu.sv implements every legal Mode-0/1/2/4/5/6/7 digital memory and port selection and accepts a separate 4-KiB FPGA mask-ROM image; rtl/hd6301/hd6301v1_bus_wrapper.sv projects every legal mode onto four digital E subphases
implementation_scope.model: model/hd6301v1_device.py independently classifies all legal-mode E-cycle transactions, program/external memory, Mode-7 GPIO/handshake state, and address errors; model/hd6301v1_bus.py separately models physical pin phases, bus ownership, reset release, and low-power states
implementation_scope.verification: A 105-check decode suite covers all legal mode maps and address-error regions, a seven-core bench executes from every program source, a 22-check cross-manufacturer Port-3 suite covers the DDR/latch/flag/strobe contract, and a 659-check pin suite plus exhaustive address projection covers the all-mode four-subphase wrapper; Mode-7 directed execution additionally covers internal reset/vector fetch, executable RAM, exact 13-cycle address TRAP, Port 3/4 GPIO, IS3/OS3, SLP, STBY, and retention
implementation_scope.excluded_modes: Mode 3 is not defined; nanosecond bus limits, oscillator recovery delay, pad behavior, and electrical characteristics remain unclaimed
